references.text: The command to pour the anointing oil over Aaron's head as part of the priestly consecration.
The recipe for the holy anointing oil and its use to consecrate Aaron and his sons.
God's command to anoint Aaron to set him apart for priestly service.
Reference to the high priest who had the anointing oil poured over his head.
Mention of the high priest who was anointed with the holy oil.
A poetic image of the precious oil running down over Aaron's head and beard.
Christ, who was anointed with the oil of gladness, fulfilling the anointing ritual.
